nodes.rationale: InputWithTags only renders when semantic_search.enabled, so search tests override config with model:'genai' (not in JINA_EMBEDDING_MODELS) to skip local model-state gating. SearchFilterGroup only renders when hasExistingSearch, so filter tests navigate with ?labels=person. Similarity search is entered via ?search_type=similarity&event_id=<id>; the planned similarity_search_id param does not exist in the app.
